warrior_attack_02.name: Battle Momentum
warrior_attack_02.description: Deal 2 damage. +1 for each other Attack card in your combo.

rogue_attack_01.name: Poison Dagger
rogue_attack_01.description: Apply Poison (1 damage each turn for 3 turns).

rogue_attack_02.name: Backstab
rogue_attack_02.description: Deal 2 damage. If this is the first attack combo of the battle, deal 4 instead.

wizard_attack_01.name: Arcane Bolt
wizard_attack_01.description: Deal 2 damage ignoring shields. +1 damage per mana spent.

wizard_defense_01.name: Magic Barrier
wizard_defense_01.description: Gain 2 Barrier. +1 Barrier per mana spent.

survivor_attack_01.name: Last Stand
survivor_attack_01.description: Deal 2 damage. If your HP is below 50%, deal 4 instead.

survivor_defense_01.name: Second Chance
survivor_defense_01.description: Return 2 cards from your discard pile to your hand.

survivor_defense_02.name: Survival Instinct
survivor_defense_02.description: If you have no Shield, restore it to maximum.

seeker_defense_01.name: Quick Survey
seeker_defense_01.description: Draw 2 cards instantly. Does not use a combo slot.

seeker_defense_02.name: Mark the Joint
seeker_defense_02.description: Mark the enemy and draw 1 card.

seeker_attack_01.name: Weak-Point Strike
seeker_attack_01.description: Deal 2 damage. If the enemy is marked, ignore shield and deal 4 instead.

improved_warrior_warpath.name: Warpath
improved_warrior_warpath.description: Gain 2 Shield. Reduce incoming damage by 25%.

improved_rogue_venom_needle.name: Venom Needle
improved_rogue_venom_needle.description: Apply Poison (2 damage each turn for 2 turns).

improved_rogue_assassinate.name: Assassinate
improved_rogue_assassinate.description: Deal 3 damage. If this is the first attack combo of the battle, deal 5 instead.

improved_wizard_arcane_lance.name: Arcane Lance
improved_wizard_arcane_lance.description: Deal 3 damage ignoring shields. +2 damage per mana spent.

improved_wizard_ward_lattice.name: Ward Lattice
improved_wizard_ward_lattice.description: Gain 3 Barrier. +2 Barrier per mana spent.

improved_survivor_blood_fury.name: Blood Fury
improved_survivor_blood_fury.description: Deal 3 damage. If your HP is below 50%, deal 5 instead.

improved_survivor_second_wind.name: Second Wind
improved_survivor_second_wind.description: Return 2 cards from your discard pile to your hand, then deal 2 damage.

improved_survivor_undying.name: Undying
improved_survivor_undying.description: Return 2 cards from your discard pile to your hand, then gain 2 Shield.

improved_seeker_deep_search.name: Deep Search
improved_seeker_deep_search.description: Draw 3 cards instantly. Does not use a combo slot.

improved_seeker_anatomy_lesson.name: Anatomy Lesson
improved_seeker_anatomy_lesson.description: Deal 2 damage. +1 damage per card drawn this battle.

improved_seeker_case_closed.name: Case Closed
improved_seeker_case_closed.description: Deal 3 damage. If the enemy is marked, ignore shield and deal 6 instead.

prisoner.name: Prisoner
prisoner.description: A fellow inmate, chained and half-starved, lashing out at anything that moves.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
giant_rat.description: Fed well on whatever the ritual left behind, and grown far past its size.

crazy_prisoner.name: Crazy Prisoner
crazy_prisoner.description: Driven mad long before the ritual, and worse now that something's finally listening to him.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: A revived guard in full kit, shield raised out of muscle memory alone.

fat_prisoner.name: Fat Prisoner
fat_prisoner.description: Swollen with whatever the ritual fed him, and furious that you interrupted his meal.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.description: The kitchen's last cook, still working with what's left in the larder.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: A knight in full plate, sword and shield still gripped tight, guarding an armory with nothing left to protect.

demon.name: Demon
demon.description: Something the ritual called up and never fully controlled, still chained to this room.

inquisitor_boss.name: The Inquisitor
inquisitor_boss.description: A former interrogator, alive and far worse for it, guarding the chapel's door out.

prison_warden_boss.name: The Prison Warden
prison_warden_boss.description: Symbol of the old order, risen to keep it intact by any means left to him.

corrupted_anarchist.name: The Resurrected Anarchist
corrupted_anarchist.description: The revolution he never finished, twisted into something that answers to the ritual instead of his cause.

warrior_shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
warrior_shield_bash.description: Braces behind the shield, then drives it forward.

warrior_reforge_guard.name: Reforge Guard
warrior_reforge_guard.description: Rebuilds a broken guard from nothing.

cutthroat_backstab.name: Backstab
cutthroat_backstab.description: Finds the gap your guard cannot cover.

cutthroat_venom_flask.name: Venom Flask
cutthroat_venom_flask.description: Something brewed in the dark and thrown.

ritualist_hex_bolt.name: Hex Bolt
ritualist_hex_bolt.description: A muttered word that lands like a stone.

ritualist_ward.name: Ritual Ward
ritualist_ward.description: Chalk and blood, holding the air still.

ritualist_dark_bolt.name: Dark Bolt
ritualist_dark_bolt.description: Passes through armour as if it were not there.

ritualist_unmaking.name: Unmaking
ritualist_unmaking.description: The ritual turned outward, all at once.

beast_bite.name: Bite
beast_bite.description: Latches on and does not let go.

beast_poison_claws.name: Poison Claws
beast_poison_claws.description: Filth under the claws does the rest.

beast_tail_whip.name: Tail Whip
beast_tail_whip.description: Turns and takes your legs out.

undead_bone_guard.name: Bone Guard
undead_bone_guard.description: What is left of the ribs still turns a blade.

undead_rise_again.name: Rise Again
undead_rise_again.description: Stands back up with its guard remade.

brute_swipe.name: Swipe
brute_swipe.description: Wide, slow, and heavy enough to matter.

brute_thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
brute_thick_hide.description: Too much bulk to cut through cleanly.

brute_cleaver.name: Cleaver
brute_cleaver.description: A tool for meat, used the same way here.

brute_crushing_blow.name: Crushing Blow
brute_crushing_blow.description: Comes down with everything behind it.

signature_warden_decree.name: The Warden's Decree
signature_warden_decree.description: The old order, enforced one last time.

signature_inquisitor_judgment.name: Judgment
signature_inquisitor_judgment.description: A sentence read out while it is carried out.

signature_anarchist_uprising.name: Final Uprising
signature_anarchist_uprising.description: The revolution he never finished, answering to something else.

prison_cell.name: Prison Cell
prison_cell.subtitle: Starting Cell
prison_cell.description: Iron bars bent outward, straw scattered across the floor. A man in shackles kneels over a dead guard, and looks up at you like he already knows your name.

cell_block.name: Cell Block
cell_block.subtitle: Cell Block
cell_block.description: Row after row of empty cells. Someone has scratched tally marks into every door on the political prisoners' side — years of them.

ritual_room.name: Ritual Room
ritual_room.subtitle: Ritual Room
ritual_room.description: A sunken circle of stone carved with wards, candles burning along every column. This is where the ritual beneath Hollowfort was cast.

underground_tunnels.name: Underground Tunnels
underground_tunnels.subtitle: Underground Tunnels
underground_tunnels.description: Old foundations beneath the fortress, lit by torches that shouldn't still be burning. Something skitters just out of the light.

central_corridor.name: Central Corridor
central_corridor.subtitle: Central Corridor
central_corridor.description: The fortress's main artery. Torches gutter over churned blood, and every door in Hollowfort seems to open off this one hall — except the mess door, which stays barred.

kitchen.name: Prison Kitchen
kitchen.subtitle: Prison Kitchen
kitchen.description: Cold ovens, spilled grain, a knife block missing every blade but one.

infirmary.name: Infirmary
infirmary.subtitle: Infirmary
infirmary.description: Rows of empty cots, bandages black with old blood. Whatever died here last did not stay down.

torture_chamber.name: Torture Chamber
torture_chamber.subtitle: Torture Chamber
torture_chamber.description: Chains creak with no one pulling them. The equipment here was built to make people talk — or stop them from ever talking again.

guard_barracks.name: Guard Barracks
guard_barracks.subtitle: Guard Barracks
guard_barracks.description: Bunks overturned, foot-lockers pried open. Whoever held this room isn't holding it anymore.

armory.name: Armory
armory.subtitle: Armory
armory.description: Weapon racks toppled across the floor, suits of armor still standing at attention along the walls.

dining_hall.name: Dining Hall
dining_hall.subtitle: Dining Hall
dining_hall.description: Long tables set for a meal that never happened, chandeliers still lit above the empty benches.

central_courtyard.name: Central Courtyard
central_courtyard.subtitle: Branching Courtyard
central_courtyard.description: Open sky at last, choked with smoke. Three doors face you across the stone — a chapel, a tower, and the political wing. Once you commit, the other two will seal.

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.subtitle: Final Branch · Chapel
chapel.description: Candlelight over a desecrated altar. The Inquisitor kneels before it, and rises the instant he hears you.

warden_tower.name: Warden's Tower
warden_tower.subtitle: Final Branch · Tower
warden_tower.description: Papers scattered everywhere, a chair overturned. The Warden himself is very much returned from the dead.

political_wing.name: Political Wing
political_wing.subtitle: Final Branch · Political Wing
political_wing.description: The cells where the crown kept its heretics. The Anarchist you met at the start is here too — or something wearing what's left of him.

exit_gate.name: Exit Gate
exit_gate.subtitle: Escape
exit_gate.description: Sunlight through the portcullis. Whichever door you took, this is where every path out of Hollowfort ends.

nothing_happens.title: Nothing Happens
nothing_happens.description: The uprising pauses. Footsteps fade. For a moment, you are alone between factions.

undead_patrol.title: Undead Patrol
undead_patrol.description: Resurrected inmates sweep the corridor. You duck aside — a card slips from your grip.

find_herbs.title: Find Herbs
find_herbs.description: Bitter prison moss grows between stones near the old gallows. It steadies the nerves.

hidden_stash.title: Anarchist Stash
hidden_stash.description: A loose brick hides a forgotten revolutionary cache. Someone meant to come back for this.

hanging_ambush.title: Gallows Ambush
hanging_ambush.description: A hanging corpse drops from the rafters. You fight free, but your grip falters.

wounded_rumor.title: Whispered Rumor
wounded_rumor.description: A half-mad inmate whispers of faction lines — Anarchists, Guards, and a sorcerer's trail.

collapsed_corridor.title: Collapsed Corridor
collapsed_corridor.description: Stone groans as the uprising shakes the foundations. Dust and panic scramble your cards.

guard_whistle.title: Guard Whistle
guard_whistle.description: A surviving watchman signals. Order still holds a pocket of the fortress — for now.

riot_shuffle.title: Corridor Riot
riot_shuffle.description: Bodies surge past. Your carefully ordered cards are torn into chaos.

press_gang.title: Press Gang
press_gang.description: Faction recruiters shove a spare blade into your pack — whether you wanted it or not.

warden_tax.title: Warden's Tax
warden_tax.description: A tax collector of the old order pries at your guard. Your shield wavers.

stolen_buckler.title: Stolen Buckler
stolen_buckler.description: You pry a cracked buckler from a fallen guard. It will not last, but it holds for now.

armorer_scrap.title: Armorer's Scrap
armorer_scrap.description: A half-mad smith hammers a patch onto your guard — crude, but it holds for now.

poisoned_rivet.title: Poisoned Rivet
poisoned_rivet.description: Corrosion eats at your armor. Your guard weakens.

arcane_residue.title: Arcane Residue
arcane_residue.description: A cracked ward-stone still hums. The leftover charge settles behind your eyes.

null_ward.title: Null Ward
null_ward.description: A dead mage's seal flares once and drinks the air. Your focus thins.

smuggled_raise.title: Smuggled Raise Shield
smuggled_raise.description: An Anarchist slips you a battered Raise Shield card. It joins your pack.

dead_anarchist.name: The Dead Anarchist
dead_anarchist.description: A resurrected political prisoner who points you at the Warden.
dead_anarchist.line0: You're not the one I came for. But the door's open regardless.
dead_anarchist.line1: They buried me for a revolution I never finished. Seems I'm needed again.
dead_anarchist.line2: The Warden still gives orders from his tower, dead or not. Kill him, and this fortress falls apart.

sorcerer.name: The Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: The mage behind the ritual, revealed once the Demon falls.
sorcerer.line0: You put the demon down. Good. Now you work for me.
sorcerer.line1: I need dried lavender from the Infirmary and a lowcap mushroom from the tunnels beneath.
sorcerer.line2: Bring them back and I'll open the corridor. That is the only way through.
sorcerer.followUp0: Lavender. Mushroom. The circle will hold a little longer.
sorcerer.followUp1: The Inquisitor still sits on the other half of this ritual in the chapel.
sorcerer.followUp2: Kill him, and the wards stop answering to anyone but me. The corridor is yours.

smuggler.name: The Smuggler
smuggler.description: A corridor rat who sells restoratives for crowns — no questions, no refunds.
smuggler.line0: Keep your voice down. Crowns talk louder than prayers in this hall.
smuggler.line1: Shield patch or a shot of focus — pick one. I don't do charity.
smuggler.line2: You want to walk out of Hollowfort, you'll pay for the privilege of standing.

executioner.name: The Executioner
executioner.description: He offers a keyring that opens the mess door off the corridor.
executioner.line0: I hanged my own bride on the Warden's order. Called it duty, once.
executioner.line1: That barred door into the Dining Hall? Staff keyring's on the hook. Take it.
executioner.line2: Three doors past the courtyard: chapel, tower, political wing. Pick your poison.

guard_captain.name: The Guard Captain
guard_captain.description: Still holding the courtyard, asking you to end the Resurrected Anarchist.
guard_captain.line0: Still barking orders, still holding this courtyard by will alone. You're not what I expected.
guard_captain.line1: The Resurrected Anarchist is stirring up the political wing. Put him down before he leads a real uprising.
guard_captain.line2: Chapel, tower, political wing — choose your door. The others seal the moment you do.

gate_dead_anarchist.name: The Dead Anarchist
gate_dead_anarchist.description: Waiting at the gate after the Warden falls.
gate_dead_anarchist.line0: The Warden's finished. Whatever kept this fortress standing dies with him.
gate_dead_anarchist.line1: Funny — I only wanted my own freedom. Seems I bought everyone's.
gate_dead_anarchist.line2: Go on. The gate's yours now.

gate_sorcerer.name: The Sorcerer
gate_sorcerer.description: Waiting at the gate after the Inquisitor falls.
gate_sorcerer.line0: The Inquisitor is finished, and so is his half of the ritual.
gate_sorcerer.line1: Whatever this fortress becomes now, it won't be his design.
gate_sorcerer.line2: The gate is open. I have no further use for it.

gate_guard_captain.name: The Guard Captain
gate_guard_captain.description: Waiting at the gate after the Resurrected Anarchist falls.
gate_guard_captain.line0: The Anarchist's revolt ends here, with him.
gate_guard_captain.line1: I kept my word. The gate is yours, prisoner.
gate_guard_captain.line2: Go — before I remember what you are.

undefined.name: The Final Door
undefined.description: Choose a path out of Hollowfort — chapel, tower, or political wing. The other two will be lost to you.

kill_warden.name: The Warden Must Die
kill_warden.description: The Dead Anarchist wants the Prison Warden dead. He waits in the tower beyond the courtyard.

gather_ritual_ingredients.name: Ingredients for the Circle
gather_ritual_ingredients.description: The Sorcerer needs dried lavender from the Infirmary and a lowcap mushroom from the Underground Tunnels before he will let you pass.

find_dining_way.name: The Locked Mess
find_dining_way.description: The door from the Central Corridor into the Dining Hall is barred. Find another way — through the Kitchen, or get the Executioner's keyring from the Torture Chamber.

kill_inquisitor.name: Silence the Inquisitor
kill_inquisitor.description: The freed Sorcerer wants the Inquisitor destroyed before he finishes his work in the chapel.

kill_resurrected_anarchist.name: End the Uprising
kill_resurrected_anarchist.description: The Guard Captain wants the Resurrected Anarchist put down before he leads the political wing into open revolt.

lowcap_mushroom.name: Lowcap Mushroom
lowcap_mushroom.description: Pale fungus from the tunnels — a ritual ingredient

dining_keyring.name: Dining Keyring
dining_keyring.description: Opens the barred door from the Central Corridor into the Dining Hall
